articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Discrete-Time System with Time-Varying Delay Based on Generalized Reciprocally Convex Matrix Inequality
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper concerns the stability analysis of discrete-time systems(DTS) with a time-varying delay(TVD). Firstly, by adding double summation terms, an appropraite Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is constructed. Then, the generalized reciprocally convex matrix inequality(GRCMI), together with the Jensen-based summation inequality(JBI) and the Wirtinger-based summation inequality(WBI), is used to estimate the forward difference of the LKF. Finally, a new delay-dependent stability criterion is established. The stability criterion show lower conservatism and require lower computational burden than results previously proposed, whose advantages are demonstrated via a numerical instance.

articleTitle: Research on the Coefficients of Multi-node Bilateral Control Model Determined by Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the development of communication technology, information transmission between vehicles has changed from onboard sensors to wireless communication technology. Considering the change of information flow topology from bilateral control to multi-node bilateral control, the weight distribution of different vehicle node information in the control strategy has become a very important issue. In this paper, the symmetry weight is studied and the weight coefficients of vehicle nodes are obtained by using the least square method to approximate the design function under the premise of ensuring the stability. Taking into account the exponential function can have a rapid rate of change, this paper uses it as a design function to generate the weight coefficient of the vehicle node. The function can effectively improve the anti-interference performance of the system and promote the traffic flow to reach the stable state more quickly, which is verified by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Electric Control Valve Based on WPT-TWSVM
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: When the electric control valve fails, the flow signal will change slightly, and it will be mixed with a lot of environmental and system noise information. In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the flow signal and reduce the noise, based on the energy decomposition of the wavelet packet, threshold processing and reconstruction are performed to achieve noise reduction. At the same time, the twin support vector machine method is used to classify minor faults. Finally, a simulation experiment was carried out on a semi-physical test bench for actuator failure simulation to verify the method proposed in this paper. The WPT optimized TWSVM model can diagnose the fault of the electric regulating valve more efficiently and quickly. This method breaks the wavelet threshold noise reduction processing. The limitations of traditional support vector machine classification have improved the accuracy and speed of recognition, improved the shortcomings of large signal noise and slow classification processing speed. It has certain promotion and application value in various industrial actuator fault monitoring and regulating valve, control valve minor fault classification, etc.

articleTitle: Measurement Method for Helicopter Rotor Motion Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Objetive:To realize real-time measurement and monitoring of helicopter motion state, based on fully considering the rotor measurement environment, power supply, information storage, processing, and information transmission, a set of rotor motion parameter test system based on vision is designed. The system adopts a non-contact measurement method, which can realize the real-time measurement and monitoring of the rotor state. Method: First, the overall design of the rotor motion state test scheme is given, and the working principle and flow chart are provided. Then combined with the actual measurement environment, it presents the concrete method of camera calibration and data processing. Result: The measurement accuracy under this type of selection and layout is evaluated. After satisfying the design accuracy, the test environment is set up in the laboratory, and the measurement accuracy is assessed through the actual test. Experimental results indicate that the measurement accuracy of the system is better than 1cm for the rotor of 8m, when the measurement baseline is 350mm, and the image recognition is better than 0.5 pixels. Conclusion: It can satisfy the system requirements of online, state accuracy measurement.

articleTitle: Attitude control for quadrotor UAV with dead zone and external disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates adaptive attitude control for quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with dead zone and external disturbance. A attitude controller is designed based on backstepping, and adaptive law is designed to compensate the influence of input dead zone and external disturbance. The designed controller guarantees that attitude angle of quadrotor UAV can trace the desired attitude angle. Finally, simulation results have demonstrated the effectiveness of the designed scheme.

articleTitle: Design of an indoor map construction and target detection technology platform based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, a variety of intelligent home robot devices have emerged on the market. According to the analysis of the functional requirements of intelligent home robot system and combining with the actual situation, this paper designs an application experiment platform combined visual localization and map building (SLAM) technology, target recognition technology and movement control technology. The platform uses the ROS operating system to implement the overall algorithm and function. The STM32F4 is used to control the movement of the vehicle body, and the Raspberry Pi 4B is used to process the visual information collected by the Intel RealSense D435 depth camera, so as to complete the construction of the indoor map and the detection of the specified target, and complete the follow-up tasks.

articleTitle: Distributed finite-time control of 2D stochastic nonlinear diffusion systems over mobile collocated actuator-sensor pairs
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper considers distributed control of stochastic nonlinear diffusion systems(SNDSs) in two-dimensional(2D) space. The finite-time feedback controller is designed with the velocity of moving collocated actuator-sensor devices such that the state of the diffusion process converges to zero in a short time. The coexistence of nonlinear term and stochastic disturbance makes the stability analysis of system are with new challenges. With mobile sensing and actuation approach, an optimal framework is presented for the diffusion system to enhance the performance. By referring to operator-dependent Lyapunov functional, several sufficient criteria which including the velocity of each moving collocated actuator-sensor pair are established on mean square finite-time stabilization of SNDSs. Numerical simulations give an insight on the effects of controlled 2D systems.

articleTitle: Non-reference image quality evaluation method based on HVS characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to effectively measure the image quality of different distortion types, a non-reference image quality evaluation algorithm based on natural scene statistics (NSS) model is proposed. This algorithm uses the statistical characteristics of the normalized brightness coefficients of natural images to tend to obey the characteristics of the generalized Gaussian probability distribution. Firstly, the regions of interest and non-interest regions of natural images are extracted, and then the image features are extracted in the corresponding regions, and finally realized image quality evaluation method based on visual regions of interest. Based on the LIVE2 image database, a large number of experiments are performed and compared with other classic algorithms. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm in this paper has high subjective consistency in the evaluation results of degraded images with multiple types of distortion coexisting, and can accurately reflect the visual perception quality of the human eye.

articleTitle: Fuel Economic optimization Analysis for Hybrid Electric Bus Based on Stochastic Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to improve the adaptability and fuel economy of hybrid electric vehicle energy management strategy, a design method of energy management strategy based on stochastic dynamic programming is proposed. Taking the typical working conditions of hybrid electric vehicles as data samples, the vehicle torque demand is abstracted as a Markov process varying with vehicle speed. Taking the deviation of fuel consumption and battery final state of charge as the cost function of vehicle optimal control, the vehicle optimal control problem is established. The value iteration method is used to solve the optimal control strategy. Finally, the simulation of the control strategy is carried out based on the vehicle forward model. The results show that the fuel economy of the proposed control strategy is 26.5% higher than that of the rule-based control strategy on the basis of meeting the target conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Structure of Vapor Recompression Heat Pump Dividing-wall Column for Separating Narrow Boiling Point Mixture
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Dividing-wall column (DWC) is a special type of thermally coupled distillation. DWC is a common distillation column with a vertical separator, which realizes the function of two columns. This structure enables mass transfer and heat transfer of multiple feed streams in the column at the same time, and realizes the separation task in a column shell which usually needs a conventional distillation sequence. So DWC has unique topology and huge energy saving advantages. However, it is found that a considerable part of the heat provided by the DWC reboiler is removed through the overhead condenser, resulting in a waste of energy. Aiming at three kinds of DWC for separating ternary narrow boiling point mixture, this paper proposes the combination of vapor recompression heat pump (VRHP) and DWC using N-Pentane, Cyclopentane, Isohexane as the input mixture to explore the effectiveness of adding VRHP to DWC to save energy. The optimal steady-state structure of DWC-VRHP is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Vertical Take-off and Landing Control of New VTOL Aircraft Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The tilt-rotor UAV is a new type of aircraft that has received extensive attention in recent years. It has both a fast-moving fixed-wing mode and a vertical take-off and landing mode that can largely ignore terrain constraints. The dynamic model of tilt-wing uav will change greatly under different flight modes, so the design of its control scheme is very difficult and challenging. In this paper, the design scheme of a new type of variable structure vertical take-off and landing vehicle designed by the laboratory is briefly introduced at first. Then,based on its dynamic model, the decoupling control design is carried out, and a discrete active disturbance rejection controller(ADRC) is designed to control its vertical take-off and landing process. Finally, a simulation model is built and simulated in Simulink. The results show that the scheme has good tracking accuracy and stability in the process of vertical take-off and landing control.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Network Output Constraint Control for a Flexible Spacecraft System
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A boundary control law is constructed to achieve the goals of the angle tracking and vibration control for flexible spacecraft system. A boundary adaptive neural network control with backstepping technique is put forward. In the process of control design, neural networks are utilized to dispose of system parameters uncertainties characteristic. A modified barrier Lyapunov function is proposed for addressing symmetric output constraint problem. Rigorous Lyaponov analysis demonstrate the system stability. The assistance of simulations is conducive to present the validity of this paper.

articleTitle: ℓ1-induced Performance Analysis and State-Feedback Control for positive 2-D Roesser system
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of state-feedback controller is investigated for positive 2-D Roesser systems under l1-induced performance. Firstly, A necessary and sufficient condition for asymptotic stability and l1-induced performance of positive 2-D system is proposed in terms of linear inequalities. Based on this, a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of desired state-feedback controllers is derived, firstlynovel and an iterative convex optimization approach is developed to solve the condition. Finally, the theoretical results are illustrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Data-driven modeling and control of proton exchange membrane fuel cell with reducing overshoot
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is widely used in many applications such as vehicle power due to its low emission and high efficiency. Dynamic modeling and control are important for PEMFC, especially for vehicles with varying loads. In this paper, a dynamic model of PEMFC and a output voltage controller are proposed to meet the varying load. Set the inlet air temperature, inlet air pressure, inlet hydrogen pressure, cooling water temperature and cooling water pressure as the input of ANN, and the output voltage as the output of ANN which is trained by experimental data. Integral separation PID controller is used to solve the problem of excessive overshoot based on ANN model. Simulation results show that ANN can lit PEMFC system well and combine with integral separation PID controller successfully to control the output voltage of fuel cell reducing the maximum deviation by 50% compared to traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: Application of maximum influence in scientific collaboration network
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As global scientific researches are witnessing rapid and high-quality development, cooperation has become the development trend in scientific research. This article models social networks, explains in detail two common propagation models, and gives the definition of the problem of maximizing influence in social networks. On the basis of which, the maximization of influence is introduced into the scientific collaboration network. It's mainly used to describe the cooperative contribution between scientific research scholars, the scientific research innovation ability and the academic leadership ability of the cooperative team. This paper proposes a method to find authors with greatest influence in scientific collaboration network, in order to mine the deep information within the scientific collaboration network.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Simulation Experiment Teaching Project of Linear Inverted Pendulum Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that students cannot fully grasp the analysis and design methods of the engineering physical control system without the automatic control comprehensive experimental device in the laboratory, the virtual simulation experiment teaching design of the linear inverted pendulum control system is carried out by taking the linear first-stage inverted pendulum and the linear second-stage inverted pendulum as examples. Three-dimensional animation technology, visualization technology, computer programming technology and database technology are used to provide students with virtual simulation experiment training on the structure and disassembly of linear inverted pendulum system, as well as photoelectric encoder principle, modeling of linear inverted pendulum system, single loop PID control, double closed-loop PID control, state feedback control and LQR control. Adopting a student-centered teaching approach, and through the self-interactive virtual simulation experiment, the students master the classical nonlinear system modeling, analysis and controller design methods, and the teaching effect of “With the virtual to fill the real, deep interaction, integration of theory and practice ” is achieved.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Alternative Advanced Convolutional Neural Networks for Train Driver Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Action accuracy of train drivers is closely related to the train safety. However, at present, the video of cabs of train drivers is difficult to be monitored in real time, along with poor alarm accuracy, long response time and difficulties in analysis of video data. Therefore, action recognition in video of the train driver is studied in this paper. First, based on the clips of collected video, the emergence of key actions in the whole video can be distinguished, and image enhancement and segmentation technology can be used to extract the images of key actions. Second, three improved convolutional neural networks (C3D, R(2+1)D and R3D) are compared to realize accurate recognition of actions. Third, a comparative experiment based on pre-training models and non-pre-training models is designed to analyze the application effects of different algorithms in this problem. The results show that the method proposed can improve the accuracy of action recognition, which effectively reduce the accidents of train driving.

articleTitle: Wedge Formation of Multiagent System by A Dynamic Leader-Follower Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Most of the existing exact formation control algorithms for multiagent systems are label-specified, i.e., the desired position for each agent in the formation is pre-specified by its label. In this paper, a self-organized control algorithm is proposed for wedge formation of a team of planar kinematic robots. The desired positions for the robots in the formation are not label-specified, but determined dynamically. By constantly forming a chain of leader-follower pairs, exact formation can be achieved by pairwise leader-follower tracking. Comprehensive simulation results are provided to evaluate the performance of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and application study of flexible wearable microstrip antenna sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the research of flexible microstrip antenna sensors, the miniaturization design of flexible microstrip antenna sensors is the focus of current research, while taking into account the performance of the sensor and wearing comfort. This paper proposes a flexible microstrip antenna sensor with simple structure, a high degree of miniaturization and a low absorption ratio (SAR) by loading rectangular slot on the surface of the radiation patch. The influence of rectangular slot parameters and radiation patch size on the performance of the flexible microstrip antenna sensor is analyzed by simulation, and the structure parameters of the flexible microstrip antenna sensor are determined. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional flexible microstrip antenna sensor, the radiation patch size of the flexible microstrip antenna sensor with rectangular slot is reduced by 44.1

articleTitle: An Iterative Algorithm for the Optimal Control of Itô Stochastic Systems with Markovian Jump
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the optimal control problem of Itô stochastic systems with Markovian jump. By using Newton's method and values of the current step with Kronecker product, a new iterative algorithm is proposed for solving the corresponding stochastic coupled Riccati matrix equations (SCAREs). Based on some simple conditions, a monotonic convergence theorem is established, and an initialization method is proposed. Furthermore, a simulation example is presented for demonstrating the superiority of our algorithm by comparing to the existing iterative algorithms.

Author Keywords: Itô stochastic systems with Markovian jump

articleTitle: Visible and Infrared Image Fusion via Superpixel Segmentation and Salient Region Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To get better performance of fusion, accurate segmentation and suitable clarity measures always play a significant part in region-based image fusion. In this paper, a novel region-based method is proposed for visible and infrared image fusion, which can effectively address the issues of inaccurate segmentation and unsuitable clarity measures. On the one hand, by applying a superpixel segmentation algorithm such as linear spectral clustering (LSC), more homogeneous regions can be acquired for fusion and the risk of generating artifacts is also decreased. On the other hand, a salient region detection method utilizing the cues of compactness and local contrast is carried out to get the saliency information of each superpixel. Moreover, by comparing the saliency values of the superpixels at the same position in visible and infrared images, the superpixels with larger saliency values are selected region by region and then the final fusion image can be generated. The experiments are conducted on six sets of visible and infrared images. In addition, four other mainstream fusion approaches are adopted for comparing the performance of fusion. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method is effective in visible and infrared image fusion problems.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on Digital Pulse Collection and Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Pulse diagnosis is an important part of traditional Chinese medicine's four examinations: looking, smelling, asking, and cutting. The pulse signal can reflect the health of the human body's internal haslets. With the development of information technology, the emergence of various pulse collection equipment and analysis algorithms provides a broad platform for the development of digital Chinese medicine. This article summarizes the currently commonly used pulse collection and analysis techniques, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of various collection and analysis methods, and finally proposes the improvement direction for the current research status, which provides a reference for the objectification of TCM diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design and Hover Control of a Tilt Tri-rotor Flying-wing Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We propose a novel tilt tri-rotor flying-wing aircraft, which consists of a flying wing and three tilting propellers configured at left, right and rear parts. In order to adapt to different flight scenarios, three flight modes are introduced and the aircraft can transform among them. To design position/attitude controllers in the hover mode, a 6-DOF dynamic model of aircraft is given. Then a cascade proportional-derivative (PD) controller is designed by means of feedback linearization and a novel control allocation method which is conducive to mode transformation is proposed. Finally, the controller is tested in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The experimental results have shown the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Research on a Synchronized Differential Calibration Method
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high-precision image measurement in the wide-area flight test measurement field, a synchronous out-of-region calibration method is proposed. The method first calculates the internal parameters of the camera through a combination of direct linear transformation algorithm and checkerboard calibration method, and then evenly arranges the target in the field of view of the camera, simultaneously acquiring the coordinates of the image point and the three-dimensional coordinates of the total station taken by the camera to form an accurate space Calibration point set. Then, the image plane is divided into N areas in the specified direction, and the external camera parameters are calculated for each area in combination with the method of resection. The experimental results show that after the sub-region calibration, the total error of the camera acquisition points is reduced by 4% (N=3) compared to the global calibration method. The algorithm can realize the calculation of camera parameters in the specified area, which basically meets the industrial measurement requirements of medium and high precision. The research in this paper can be applied to the precise measurement of small displacements in flight tests.

articleTitle: Overview of finger rehabilitation robots research
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the advent of the aging population, post-stroke will cause hand function obstacles that affect fine manipulation of fingers. This article classifies finger rehabilitation robots and analyzes the mechanical structure, driving methods, and rehabilitation principles of Unger rehabilitation robots. The advantages and disadvantages of the development of finger rehabilitation robots are summarized.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Glove for Hand-object Pressure Capture
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We propose a novel data glove for hand-object pressure capture and realize the synchronization of pressure data and video data of hand-object interaction motion. We process the collected motion video data, labeling it automatically with 2D key points of the hand gestures and segmenting the object images. Then, we process the interactive pressure data and generate a pressure data set of hand-object interaction motion with a synchronized video. Three different types of pressure sensors are used and fixed on the gloves and objects respectively to collect the data. We analyze and compare the collected pressure data using the three different sensors.

articleTitle: Integrated Guidance and Control for Semi-Strapdown Missiles with Terminal Attack Angle and Field-of-View Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents an integrated guidance and control (IGC) design scheme for the semi-strapdown missiles with the terminal attack angle and the seeker field-of-view (FOV) constraints. Firstly, an IGC model in the pitch plane is established. Then, by referring to the theory of the sliding mode control approach, an adaptive nonlinear control law is designed based on the dynamic surface control method. The control law explicitly considers the FOV constraint, and can make the missile hit the target accurately with the desired terminal attack angle. The stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed by employing the Lyapunov theory. Finally, the numerical simulation confirms the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Consensus of Strict Feedback Multi-agent Systems via Event-triggered Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: By using event-triggered technology, consensus control of multi-agent systems (MASs) with nonlinear strict feedback dynamics and directed graph will be investigated in this technical note. By employing high-gain control tool, we firstly translate the consensus problem into a stability problem. Then, we give a Riccati equation to design the event-triggered consensus controller. Moreover, we prove that, with the action of our controller, state consensus can be reached. At last, an example is presented to show the effectiveness of the given algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Airport Inspection and Disinfection Channel System Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the, face of the outbreak, due to the large passenger flow at the airport, there is a great demand, for temperature detection, disinfection and registration. At present, the intelligence degree of airport inspection and disinfection system is generally low. Problems such as disinfection and temperature measurement omission, long time consuming, low efficiency and difficulty in establishing passenger health information base are often found. In order to solve these problems and achieve the "interconnection and sharing" of passenger health information, this paper designs the airport inspection and disinfection channel system based on cloud platform. This system uses the information system based on the cloud platform, combining with the data collected by sensors, carries on the statistical processing and analysis of various information. At the same time, Back Propagation neural network algorithm is selected to compensate the ambient temperature and improve the temperature measurement accuracy. This system adopts scanning two-dimensional code to register and identify the information of passengers, and through a large user group of WeChat small program, so as to achieve information interaction with passengers. This system realizes the automation, intelligence and informatization of airport inspection and disinfection.

articleTitle: Multi-task learning for landslide displacement prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The accurate prediction of landslide displacement has very important practical significance. At present, most studies only make individual predictions for each displacement monitoring point, ignoring the contribution of the correlation among different monitoring points to the prediction results. In this paper, a novel method for landslide displacement prediction using multi-task learning is proposed. In this methodology, the displacements of different monitoring points on the same landslide surface are simultaneously predicted due to the similarity among them. Experimental results on four landslides near Huangdeng Hydropower Station in China verify the effectiveness of the multi-task method for landslide displacement prediction. In addition, considering the characteristics of landslide displacement, a hybrid prediction method combining double exponential smoothing and multi-task method is proposed. The experimental results on four real-world landslide datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the hybrid prediction method.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Based on Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Underactuated USV
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Unmanned surface vessel (USV) has been widely applied due to its advantages in the maritime security inspection and resources exploration. As a complex nonlinear system, the trajectory tracking of USV requires the controller to achieve fast tracking for a given target, and at the same time, the controller needs to have strong anti-interference capability due to the complex water surface conditions with many uncertainties and disturbances. In this paper, a backstepping sliding mode control design method for USV is proposed, and it is used to realize the trajectory tracking problem of USV. The asymptotic stability of the control system is proved by theoretical derivation, while numerical simulation is used to verify that the unmanned boat achieves the tracking control effect of open trajectory and closed trajectory in the presence of external disturbances. The simulation results show that the designed controller can track the set target quickly and accurately, and has strong disturbance resistance in the case of periodic disturbances.

articleTitle: UAV distribution optimization system for extreme fire
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: SSA UAV carries high-definition, thermal imaging and telemetry sensors, and is not limited by the terrain, so it has a wide range of applications in fire protection, patrol and other fields. When firefighters put out the fire, they can carry out auxiliary monitoring and cooperate with EOC for command. This paper studies the distribution of SSA UAV in case of fire, Taking Australia as an example, combined with the occurrence point and frequency of historical fire, Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate the extreme fire probability in each location. Taking Victoria as an example, the optimal distribution optimization model of SSA UAV is established. The immune optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem, and the optimal distribution location map is finally obtained.

articleTitle: Autonomous Obstacle Navigating System of Quadrotor UAV Based on Vision Positioning and Cascade Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To solve the problem of unstable obstacle circling process of UAV, an autonomous obstacle circling system of four-rotor UAV based on visual positioning and cascade control algorithm is designed in this paper. The system consists of a vision positioning module, an operation processing unit and a flight control module. The vision positioning module includes a monocular camera module and a laser ranging unit. After the relative position between the obstacle and the UAV is solved by the operation processing unit, the flight control module controls the four-rotor UAV to fly around the obstacle with a certain distance and complete the autonomous obstacle circling. Finally, an experiment of autonomous obstacle circumnavigation of UAV was designed based on the quadrotor platform, and the feasibility of the proposed obstacle circumnavigation scheme was verified.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Superheated Steam Temperature Control System Based on IMC-PID Cascade Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the large inertia, large delay, time-varying and nonlinear characteristics of the superheated steam temperature of thermal power plants, the cascade control and internal model control are combined to form an IMC-PID cascade control system. The design steps and parameter calculation formulas are given. The IMC-PID cascade control algorithm is simulated for the superheated steam temperature control of a 300MW unit, and compared with the traditional cascade control algorithm. The results show that the IMC-PID cascade control algorithm is stable, accurate, rapid and robust. The anti-interference performance is better than the traditional cascade control algorithm, and the setting method is simple, which has good engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Path Planning of Jump-Wheeled Lunar Rover
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a jump-wheeled lunar rover is designed, which is capable of walking and jumping. The lunar rover relies on its wheels to move in flat areas, and jumps over obstacles by its inertial wheel in complex and rugged areas. Firstly, kinematics and dynamics modeling are carried out for the rover. The lunar surface is photographed by camera during the jumping process, which is then changed into a grid map. Finally, the take-off point of each step is generated by Q-Learning.

articleTitle: A Boolean operation based off-line full coverage path planning strategy for industry robot
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This research aims to develop a robot trajectory rapid generation strategy for industry robots. On the basis of Boolean operation, this work is implemented in an off-line programming environment name Robotstudio (product of ABB, Swiss), the basic principle of this method is to generated a series of cutting curves by the Boolean operation between coating surface and an orthogonal surface, the cutting curve is then discrete and analyzed to obtain the robot trajectory points. As shown by our simulation results, this presented strategy is to determine series of appropriate path curves that can not only minimize the total length of subsequent curves but also ensure the distance consistency among offset curves, thus it is suitable for industry robot application.

articleTitle: Calculation of coronary artery non-invasive blood flow reserve fraction based on combination of digital and analog
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the clinical status of the evaluation of functional coronary stenosis that requires invasive surgery to determine the fractional flow reserve (FFR), this study aims to use an in vitro non-invasive detection method, which uses computer tomography to obtain two-dimensional CT images of patients, uses fluid dynamics simulation methods to establish patient-specific models in vitro, and then performs hemodynamic values on the patient's real blood flow. Analyze and explore the relationship between different hemodynamic parameters and coronary artery stenosis, non-invasively calculate the blood flow reserve score to assess the degree of coronary artery stenosis lesions, and dig out hidden data. A total of 3 patients with real CT data whose image quality meets the modeling requirements were included in the study. After calculation, the noninvasive blood flow reserve fraction of each stenosis site was obtained. SPSS software was used to analyze the calculated value of the model and the blood flow reserve fraction measured at each stenosis site, and the Pearson correlation coefficient of the two was. 1. Meanwhile, the dynamic changes of the stenosis can be obtained by analyzing the main parameters of hemodynamics.This study shows that the method of evaluating coronary stenosis lesions using fluid mechanics non-created model has a good correlation with the measured blood flow reserve (FFR) during angiography, which can provide an important reference for clinical diagnosis and greatly reduce the pain that patients need to bear during surgery.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Passive Control for Conic-Type Markov Jump Systems with Mode-Dependent Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The passive controller design issue for conic-type nonlinear Markov jump systems with unmeasurable states and mode-dependent uncertainties is considered in this paper. Firstly, we construct a appropriate observer and state feedback controller and design an error dynamic system. Then, an suitable Lyapunov-Krasovskii function is selected to guarantee the error dynamic system be stochastic stable and fulfills the given passive performance indicator. In the end, the validity of the presented approach is demonstrated by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Target Recognition Method of Flight Vehicle Based on Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The key factor in obtaining flight vehicle guidance information is the automatic recognition of strapdown images. When using strap-down image guidance, it is more difficult to obtain guidance information due to the influence of environment and other factors on the information collection. Aiming at the fact that deep learning algorithms cannot be directly applied to the target recognition of strapdown images, a new target recognition framework is proposed. The framework extracts features from target template images and strapdown images, and uses the extracted feature maps as the input of the deep neural network, so that the improved target recognition framework can be directly applied to the strapdown environment. Experimental results show that the proposed framework can effectively recognize strapdown images, improve recognition accuracy, and achieve precise guidance.

articleTitle: Finite Time Stability of Octonion-Valued Neural Networks With Delays
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the finite time stability (FTS) of octonion-valued neural networks (OVNNs) with unbounded asynchronous time delays (UADs) by adopting two-phases-method (2PM) and 2-norm. Without employing traditional decomposition method or supposing the terms with delays are bounded, and utilizing a new sign function for octonion, we design the controller with only two terms only depending on the present system state, which can cut down redundancy in calculation and reasoning, and the controller would be much easier to realize in practical situations. Moreover, the adaptive FTS of OVNNs is also realized. Finally, two numerical examples are also given.

articleTitle: A Novel Data and Model Hybrid-Driven Method for Image Restoration Using Residual Dense Attention U-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As people's pursuit of large screen-to-body ratio screen experience continues to improve, neither the digging front camera nor the bangs front camera can meet people's requirements for the front camera of a mobile phone. Therefore, the research and development of full-screen equipment has become a new trend. A full-screen device requires the imaging device to be placed below the screen, which we call an under-display cameras. The under-display cameras will improve the user's interactive experience while expanding the screen-to-body ratio of the mobile phone. However, there are many problems in the development of under-display cameras. When the imaging device is installed under the screen, the lower light transmittance will cause serious image degradation. Therefore, a new U-Net, which we call residual dense attention UNet (RDAU-Net), is proposed in this paper. A residual dense attention module which we propose in RDAU-Net to replace the single-layer convolution in the U-Net network. Meanwhile, the introduction of channel attention can effectively enhance the interdependence between channels, thereby adaptively re-dividing channel features. Experiments show that our RDAU-Net has better accuracy and faster recovery efficiency than existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Temperature of Cement Rotary Kiln Burning Zone Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the cement rotary kiln burning system, the temperature of the burning zone is a key factor affecting the quality of cement clinker. At present, the temperature in the burning zone of most domestic cement rotary kilns is set manually, and the burning system is complex, making it difficult to establish an accurate mathematical model. Aiming at the this problems, a method of setting the burning temperature based on data mining is proposed and experiments are carried out. This article first introduces the cement production process and burning parameters, through data preprocessing, grey correlation analysis to determine the parameters, fuzzy c-means to construct the fuzzy set process to get the data form suitable for data mining. finally, the association rule mining algorithm is used to mine the temperature setting value of the burning zone that meets the production requirements. The experimental results show that the temperature setting method of the burning zone based on data mining can mine the temperature of the burning that meets the production requirements, which is of great significance for reducing coal consumption and improving the quality of clinker.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm for Multiplication and Inverse of a Class of Lower Triangular Matrices and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We propose a method to search the inverse matrix for a type of special multiplied triangular matrix quickly. The proposed method can be used for the decomposition of Diagonal matrix, Lower triangular matrix and Upper triangular matrix (LDU) of a square matrix, and can effectively reduce the complexity of calculation and improve the operation efficiency. The simulation results verify the convenience and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on kiln current feature extraction method based on sliding average-linearization
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the problem of kiln current feature extraction of cement rotary kiln, the kiln current data of a cement factory in Shandong Province is used as the object, and the sliding average and linearization method was adopted to extract the features of kiln current time series. This paper introduces a time series feature extraction method based on sliding average and linearization, and complements the experiments. Through the process of data acquisition, outlier elimination, sliding average filtering and linearization, the kiln current trend feature is obtained. The experimental results show that this method has high data compression ratio and accurate trend feature representation. This method is of great significance to cement burning system control and paves the way for the next step of data mining.

articleTitle: 3D Beam Tracking Method Based on Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Assistant for Blocking Channel
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a method is proposed to track for the three-dimensional beam of the blocking channel, which can be used in the wireless communications of complex environment, and in remote villages, etc. The proposed beam tracking method can finish beam tracking accurately by establishing a new communication system with the reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) and optimizing the wireless parameters. To finish the main task for tracking the beam, the problem is divided into three parts. Firstly, the problem of the blocking channel is solved by configuring the RIS which is a promising technology and can reflect the received signal intelligently. Secondly, a beam tracking method is proposed based on the characteristics of both the angle velocities and the RIS. The core of this method is to estimate the angular velocities of the unmanned aerial vehicle while receiving the pilot symbols and to predict the azimuth and elevation angles in the following time blocks without sending new pilots. Finally, the communication effect can be optimized by adjusting the phase shift of each uniform linear array equipped on the RIS. The simulations are implemented in MATLAB and the final results can demonstrate the applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Autoencoder with a Memory Module for Video Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rise of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), considerable attention has been paid to video anomaly detection (VAD). Autoencoders are a popular type of framework for VAD, and many existing VAD methods are based on it. However, these methods take an assumption of closed-world VAD, i.e., do not comprehensively consider the diversity of normal patterns. Besides, a competent CNN allows the autoencoder to reconstruct or predict abnormal video frames proficiently, resulting in missing anomalies. To mitigate these drawbacks, we propose an Autoencoder with a Memory Module (AMM) to realize video anomaly detection by predicting video frames. AMM consists of three modules: an encoder, a decoder, and a memory module. First, the consecutive frames are fed into the encoder to yield latent spatial features. Then, the features are utilized to retrieve corresponding memory items in the memory module to generate memory mapping features. Finally, the memory mapping features are adopted in the decoder for predicting the next frame. To match the queries against memory items accurately, we propose a memory triplet loss, which takes into account both size and angle discrepancies between the queries and memory items. At the training stage, AMM utilizes the memory triplet loss, a prediction loss, and multi-scale structure similarity measure. Moreover, the modes of retrieving and updating memory items are ameliorated by a scaled dot product model, which can alleviate vanishing gradient problems to a certain extent. Extensive experiments are conducted on three benchmark public datasets, and the results demonstrate the superior performance of AMM.

articleTitle: HSIL Colposcopy Image Segmentation Using Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The screening and diagnosis of cervical lesions can effectively reduce the risk of cervical cancer. At present, there are few research algorithms and models for colposcopy in cervical lesion image segmentation. If image about colposcopy can be directly used to automatically segment the precancerous lesion area of cervical cancer, it will help doctors to make a faster and more accurate diagnosis, which has important clinical significance. To resolve this conundrum, this paper proposes an improved U-Net network image segmentation method for cervical squamous intraepithelia[1] lesions. Firstly, a sub-coding module is embedded in each layer of the U-Net encoder structure to improve its feature extraction capability. Secondly, dense connection is added to the lowest level convolution operation to solve the problem that the gradient disappears as the network deepens. Compared with U-Net, FCN and SegNet, the precision, Dice coefficient, IOU and Recall evaluation indexes of the model were better in this study, which effectively realized the image segmentation of cervical squamous intraepithelial lesions.

articleTitle: Pre-specified-time coordination algorithm for convex optimization problems over weight-unbalanced networks
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates a group of convex optimization problems for swarm systems with directed and weight-unbalanced topologies, such as the economic dispatch problems with equality constraints. By using the multi-step planning method, a new pre-specified-time coordination algorithm is proposed to seek the optimal value of global objective function in a distributed manner. Here, the specified time represents the moment when convex optimization problem gets solution, which can be appointed in advance without additional fuzzy estimation. In addition, the convergence time of the proposed algorithm is calculated precisely with the aid of Kronecker matrix algebra and Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, some simulations are shown to demonstrate the usefulness and superiority of the new designed optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Autonomous Navigation for Orchard Mobile Robots: A Rough Review
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Autonomous navigation is the premise of the application of intelligent orchard machinery, which can help the orchard mobile robot to carry out multi-functional operations without human control. This paper describes the current research status of orchard autonomous navigation technologies, mainly discusses sensing solutions for autonomous navigation in orchard, navigation data processing algorithms and navigation control strategies. First, existing single-sensor based navigation solutions in orchard and their limitations are described. Multi-sensor based navigation has high accuracy, which is the development trend of orchard navigation in the future. Second, navigation data processing algorithms is the key of environmental perception and path planning for orchard robots. Different algorithms for orchard feature extraction and data fusion are introduced. Third, navigation control strategies are discussed.

articleTitle: Vehicle Behavior Recognition using Multi-Stream 3D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Vehicle behavior recognition take an essential part in the community of intelligent driving assistance systems. Recent approaches with 3D convolutional neural network (3DCNN) achieve reasonable recognition performance in laboratory settings. However, due to the complexity of network, the model is large and the reasoning is slow, so it is difficult to be applied in practice. In order to better handle the trade-off between size, precision and reasoning speed,a lightweight multi-stream 3DCNN model is proposed in this paper, which achieves fast reasoning speed and small model size while maintaining high precision. The 3DCNN model consists of three parts. Firstly, the module of SELayer-3DCNN is developed to extract appearance information from the RGB image sequence. The motion and edge information are also extracted from the optical flow sequence and edge image sequence, respectively. The edge information is applied to enhance the optical flow features. Secondly, a novel channel attention fusion strategy is proposed to improve the feature fusion and network ability. Finally, a 3D-RFB module is proposed to enhance the receptive field of the convolutional kernel. Furthermore, this paper presents a dataset of vehicle behavior. The advantages of the proposed method are verified by ablation experiments and comparative experiments while the real-time characteristics are maintained.

articleTitle: Observer-based Event-triggered Robust Control for Input Constrained Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an adaptive dynamic programming (ADP)-based event-triggered robust control (ETRC) method for continuous-time input constrained nonlinear systems with uncertainties. By constructing a neural network (NN) observer, the estimated uncertainties are employed to design a novel value function, which reflects the real-time uncertainties, regulation and control input simultaneously. Then, a critic-only structure is adopted to approximate the value function and obtain the control law. Based on the event-triggered strategy, the control law is updated when events occur. Thus, the computational burden is reduced, and communication resources and bandwidths are saved. Furthermore, we prove that the closed-loop system and the approximate error of the critic NN weights are both uniformly ultimately bounded by using Lyapunov's direct method. Finally, an example is employed to verify the effectiveness of the developed ETRC method.

articleTitle: Analysis of main damage accumulative surfaces of the Hypersonic Flight Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of performance degradation of Hypersonic Flight Vehicle during damage-mitigating control, this paper analyzes the main damage accumulative surfaces under different flight dynamics. Firstly, the force model of the flight vehicle is established; secondly, establish the longitudinal elastic model and the damage model of the flight vehicle; finally, select four actual flight dynamics and fully consider the influence of elastic factors, and analyze the main damage accumulation surfaces under each flight dynamic. The simulation results show that the main damage accumulative surfaces of the flight vehicle under different flight dynamics are different, and the main damage accumulative surfaces are mostly the upper surface of the flight vehicle and the lower surface of the precursor. The strategy that defers the damage of the main damage accumulative surfaces should be adopted, which can not only effectively decrease the damage accumulative of the flight vehicle, but also protect the original performance of the flight vehicle.

articleTitle: Health Status Evaluation of Radar Transmitter Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of health status evaluation of radar transmitter, a health status evaluation method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is proposed. In this study, we first select the main influencing factors of radar transmitter, and improve the health status evaluation index set and evaluation set. This paper uses the relative degradation degree to represent the degree of deviation between the evaluation index data and the index data under normal conditions. The evaluation method uses the ridge membership function to determine the index membership and compares it with the triangular membership function. The weight determined by analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy weight method is combined by combination weighting method. Then fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to integrate the determined membership degree and weight to obtain the health grade membership matrix of the first level health status evaluation index. According to the principle of maximum membership degree, the health status of the first level health status evaluation index is obtained. Finally the maximum eigenvalue of the judgment matrix in the AHP is used to obtain the weight vector of each first-level health status evaluation index, and the overall evaluation result of the radar transmitter is finally determined. The calculation example analysis shows that the method can more accurately reflect the operating status of the radar transmitter, which can provide a reference for logistical support.

articleTitle: TCM Syndrome Differentiation Based on Artificial Bee Colony Optimization BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Dialectics is one of the key points of TCM diagnosis. It takes the clinical symptoms of traditional Chinese medicine through dialectical diagnosis and treatment to obtain the patient's pathological syndrome. However, this unique method of diagnosis and treatment of Chinese medicine is difficult to quantify and express, not only because of the personal subjective experience of Chinese doctors in diagnosis and treatment, but also because of the various languages and dialectical principles of Chinese medicine that are difficult to describe in detail. The development of modern information technology has made possible the intelligent of TCM syndrome differentiation. The method of optimizing BP neural network based on artificial bee colony algorithm can find the mapping relationship between TCM symptoms and TCM syndrome types, and then realize the information of TCM syndrome differentiation auxiliary diagnosis and treatment. The intelligent auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system of Chinese medicine can realize the diagnosis and treatment of syndromes from symptoms to syndrome types, and provide reference and convenience for Chinese doctors to see a doctor.

articleTitle: Multi-segment Bidding Behaviors of Power Units: Price-capacity-pair Analysis and Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the deregulation of the power market, power units are allowed to make strategic biddings. The bidding results of the strategic bidding market are substantially different from the ones in the previous regulated market. Such differences in the bidding results will further have impacts on the power flow and system security. Thus, it is important to analyze and establish a model to simulate the bidding behaviors of the power units. This paper proposes a price-capacity-pairs model to simulate multi-segment bidding behavior. We select five vital factors that affect biddings behaviors as input: load, capacity, supply-demand ratio, bidders’ bidding tendency and unit type. Based on the three-segment bidding rule, the price-capacity pair is used. For uncertain price or capacity, we choose a truncated normal distribution model. Scenario generation and reduction are achieved by Monte Carlo simulation and fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm. We apply our method to a case study based on Guangdong’s market in China. The simulation of wind power units, coal power units and gas power units has verified the correctness of the model.

articleTitle: TCM Medical Record Analysis Algorithm Based on Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The most important step in the process of medical record analysis in TCM is the classification of medical records. The biggest challenge of medical record classification is to perceive the correlation between context words and find keywords, and make judgments based on the keyword information. In this article, we propose a TCM medical record analysis algorithm based on recurrent convolutional neural network, which introduces a maximum pooling layer in the recurrent neural network, and uses it to determine the words that play an important role in text classification to capture the key components of the text. Experimental results show that recurrent convolutional neural network achieves better results than attention recurrent neural network and traditional recurrent neural network. In addition, recurrent convolutional neural network is more than twice as fast as them in terms of training speed.

articleTitle: Circle detection method based on contour extraction and rule verification
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Product appearance visual inspection is a research hot spot in the field of industrial machine vision technology. In the manufacturing process of Flexible Integrated Circuit Substrate (FICS), the defects of circle hole on FICS surface affect the electrical connection performance between chip and substrate, so detecting the defects of circle hole on FICS surface is an important content of visual inspection. However, the surface of FICS presents local high texture characteristics and the circle hole may have edge defects, which make it difficult to accurately detect the circle hole. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a circle detection method based on contour extraction and rule verification. Firstly, a contour extraction operator is used to extract candidate circular contours from FICS surface images. Secondly, the closed contours are divided into two categories according to the roundness of the contours, where the circle hole verification method based on the Helmholtz principle is used to verify large roundness contours, the iterative least squares method is used to verify small roundness contours. Finally, parameters of the resulted circular holes are calculated to determine whether they are defective circular holes or not. Compared with classical circle detection algorithms such as random circle detection and ED circle detection, the proposed method performs better results in terms of accuracy, precision and speed. The average accuracy and recall of the proposed method are 100%, and the average detection speed is 1.6ms on the test dataset.

articleTitle: Robust Feature Matching Based on Adaptive ORB for Vision-based Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Feature matching technology is one important part for a vision navigation system to estimate robot pose according to natural landmarks. However, it is difficult for the existing techniques to solve the dilemma between accuracy, and efficiency, as well as the robustness under a complex workspace involving non-uniform illumination and texture-less. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel feature matching algorithm that is robust, accuracy, and relatively fast in complex workspaces. The main idea of the proposed method is a multi-stage matching module consisting of K Nearest Neighbor, Threshold Filtering, Eigenvector Norm, and Random Sample Consensus (KNN-TF-EN-RANSAC) to eliminate mismatches for retaining the optimal matches. Meanwhile, the proposed matching module is computed on adaptive Oriented fast and Rotated Brief (ORB) features extracted by a variable extraction radius. Finally, extensive experiments demonstrate the robustness, accuracy, and real-time performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Federated Optimization Based on Compression and Event-triggered Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Federated learning is deemed as a promising solution to large-scale machine learning problem, which enables multiple edge users cooperatively to train a global parameter model and guarantees users a basic privacy level. However, despite the increasing interest, communication expenditure usually turns out to be a major bottleneck for scaling up distributed algorithms with possibly irresponsible or limited data rate network environments. In fact, users or clients synchronize models periodically regardless of whether current models change significantly from last one, it is a waste of communication resources. Considering how much message to transmit each communication round and when to communicate, in this paper, we propose FedCET, which is a compression and event-triggered algorithm for federated learning. We present convergence analysis of algorithm and rigorous proof for smooth nonconvex, strong convex or PL condition and general convex objective functions, respectively, testifying that such communication method is efficient without affecting the convergence property of the algorithm. Further, we evaluate the proposed FedCET on several dataset to demonstrate the effectiveness compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-AGVs Dynamic Path Planning to Avoid Deadlock
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the integration of informatization and industrialization, automated guided vehicles (AGVs) are widely used in material transportation. How to plan the path of multiple AGVs so that multiple AGVs can perform tasks safely and efficiently has become the key to improving the production efficiency of enterprises. In response to this problem, this paper first analyzes the causes of path conflicts and deadlocks; then uses the grid method to build a map model while avoiding deadlocks and path conflicts, and chooses the A* algorithm to plan the path; finally, a multi-AGVs dynamic path planning method is designed with the total default time, total time, and total path length as evaluation indicators. This method searches the paths of multiple AGVs in a rolling manner, stores the paths in the OPEN table and simplifies the paths to improve the actual cost. The design simulation in this paper reduces the total default time by 45.13%, reduces the total time by 1.64%, and reduces the total path length by 0.19%, which verifies the effectiveness of the multi-AGVs dynamic path planning method.

articleTitle: Data-Based H∞ Robust Frequency Control of Multi-Area Interconnected Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Designing a reliable robust frequency controller (FC) plays a key role in modern power systems. Considering a great amount of renewable energy generation has been integrated into the local microgrid system, a data-based H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust frequency control strategy is presented for the multi-area interconnected microgrid system in this paper. Firstly, the uncertainties resulted by renewable energy output and load change are considered in the modeling process for the multi-area frequency control system. Secondly, by introducing game theory, the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control problem can be transformed to the two-player zero-sum optimal control problem. A data-based online ADP algorithm is adopted, which does not require the precise system parameters. Compared with traditional control methods, on the one hand, the control methodology does not need accurate parameters of the dynamic system, on the other hand, this control method has a good effect on suppressing external interference. Then, we theoretically derive and prove that the proposed controller can iteratively convergence to the Nash Equilibrium Solution. Finally, the Validity of the data-based H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust frequency controller is verified via simulation examples.

articleTitle: Multi-template Neuroimaging Feature Selection Using Weight-constrained Low-rank Learning for Alzheimer’s Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, much attention has been focused on the diagnosis of neurodegenerative diseases. Some studies use a single template to identify neuroimaging biomarkers for the diagnosis of brain diseases. Compared to traditional single-template based approaches, a multi-template based approach can generally take into account more and richer information and relationships between subjects than a single-template based approach, so it can usually obtain better performance. However, most existing machine learning methods focus on finding the relationship between multiple templates, ignoring subject weights or noise effectiveness in the model building process. In fact, the representations of different subjects registered under multiple templates have different distinguishing discrimination capabilities. To solve this problem, we propose multi-template neuroimaging feature selection using weight-induced low-rank learning (WILL) for early diagnosis of AD. Specifically, we first use the resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data to construct brain networks to obtain feature representations based on three different templates. Then, we adopt the WILL method to learn the weight of the subject through low-rank pattern matrix optimization, and select the most useful features for classification. Finally, based on the selected discriminative features, we apply the multi-kernel support vector machine as the classifier to get the result. Experimental results on a large number of data sets show that our proposed method is more accurate than the existing multi-template based methods, which confirms the superiority of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Smart contracts based supply chain resource management system in the industrial internet
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to address the inconvenience and opaqueness issues existing in the scenario of ordering resources for manufacturing companies, in this paper, we design a supply chain resource management system based on the blockchain technology. A deserving resource smart contract (DRSC) and a punishment smart contract (PSC) are developed to deal with the environment of transactions, and a resource allocation method is proposed to obtain an optimal strategy. Finally, simulation is carried out to verify the feasibility of the designed system and illustrate a final allocation strategy maximizing the overall profits.

articleTitle: Event-triggered resilient network-level control of multi-agent systems under cyber attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the resilient cooperative control of multi-agent systems against potential cyber attacks. The attacker aims to make the consensus dynamics diverge by inserting external signals to the communication network and modify the information being exchanged. An event-triggered network-level defense mechanism with virtual systems is developed, under which the multi-agent system can reach leader-follower consensus in the presence of unknown attacks. The strategy proposed in this paper can handle the unknown cyber attacks without estimation-based compensators and has the advantage of not interfering the system during normal operations. Furthermore, the event-triggered strategy avoids the continuous communications among neighboring agents.

articleTitle: State of charge estimation for Li-ion battery based on LSSVR and CKF
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The Lion-ion battery state of charge (SOC) Estimation is an ever significant issue for the intelligent battery management system. Our study aims to estimate the state of charge Lion-ion battery from experimental data sets using the Dynamic least square support vector regression (DLSSVR) approach. In addition, Cubature Kalman Filter (CKF) was used to help find the optimized parameter for DLSSVR. The operation of the algorithm has been validated upon Federal Urban Driving Schedule (FUDS) of 10 C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>, 20 C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>, 30 C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>. The simulation conducted upon LSSVR and (DLSSVR + CKF), the result of which shows that the method of this paper(DLSSVR + CKF) can estimate SOC of li-ion battery with good accuracy and robustness under a dynamic environment.

articleTitle: False Invoicing Feature Identification and Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the behavior of false invoicing by enterprises disturbs the tax order and even harms the national interests, which has become a hot issue of social concern. Tax authorities can crack down on enterprises' false invoicing according to risk characteristics. In this paper, we analyze these behavioral characteristics. By comparing the prediction performance of each algorithm e.g. Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, BP neural network, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Decision Tree and GBoost classification that based on historical case data, we select that the Random Forest which is the one with the highest prediction accuracy as the final model. We use extended data to deal with complex features, and propose a high-precision prediction model based on Random Forest, which is more intelligent and efficient than traditional ones, so as to provide accurate decision-making basis for the prediction of enterprises false invoicing.

articleTitle: A Pick-and-Throw Method for Enhancing Robotic Sorting Ability via Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To promote the work capacity and efficiency in a weakly structured logistics sorting scene, a pick-and-throw method based on reinforcement learning is proposed. First, a D N-based learning algorithm is used to obtain a picking feasibility distribution map for guiding an optimal picking action. Second, Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm is utilized to train a throwing policy. The throwing policy outputs a throwing velocity of the end-effector of a robot to throw the picked object to a target area. In addition, a memory pool optimization algorithm is also proposed to enhance the convergence of the throwing policy. Experiments are conducted in both simulation and real scenarios and results demonstrate that the proposed method can improve the sorting efficiency and expand the sorting space significantly.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm for Solving General Colored Traveling Salesman Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 36th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A colored traveling salesman problem (CTSP) is a generalization of the well-known multiple traveling salesman problem. It utilizes colors to differentiate the accessibility of its cities to ward its salesmen. All the existing algorithms for solving CTSP are serial ones. This paper presents for the first time a parallel algorithm framework for solving general CTSP. Then, an improved variable neighborhood search algorithm is proposed by using this algorithm framework. Finally, extensive simulations are conducted in various test cases. The results show that the algorithm proposed is superior to the compared serial algorithms in terms of convergence and solution quality.

articleTitle: Quantum-Behaved Multi-Robot Plume Source Localization with Formation Maintenance and Obstacle Avoidance
